name: squeeze_floor_breakdown_dip_exits
description: The converse of the noise-dip golden: an identical squeezed position hit by a DEEPER dip that breaches even the floor-CLAMPED stop distance still exits. Proves the floor protects against noise, NOT against a genuine breakdown -- the clamp raises the stop but does not disable it. GREEN at HEAD and post-impl (a deep enough dip exits under either stop distance).
derivation: Same arming as the noise-dip golden. t2 dip is deeper (ret -0.20). NEW (floor): stop_level=0.15-0.15=0.0, threshold=0.0-0.10=-0.10; ret -0.20 <= -0.10 -> EXIT 'Trailing Stop'. OLD (no floor): stop_level=0.075, threshold=-0.025; ret -0.20 <= -0.025 -> EXIT too. Both exit -> the floor did not suppress a genuine breakdown.
